question:
Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.

Any book on any subject risks irrelevance or smallness compared to this (behemoth).
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bracketed word** "behemoth"** refers to something enormous or gigantic. Hindi meaning (विशाल, दिग्गज).
 
• The correct antonym **"Midget"** refers to something very small or tiny. Hindi meaning (बौना, छोटा).

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **'Midget'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Monster" **refers to an imaginary creature that is typically large, ugly, and frightening.(राक्षस, दानव).
 
• Option 2: **"Colossus"** means a statue that is much bigger than life size; or something enormous in size.(विशाल प्रतिमा, दिग्गज).
 
• Option 3: **"Dreadnought"** refers to a type of battleship or something that is fearless.(लड़ाकू जहाज, निर्भीक).

3e:Taeb,
The correct answer is 'Option 2'</strong&g
